_comment: Findings (warnings) of the five design gates on an approved real project (142 parts). A gate may not report more than this; fewer is an improvement. M10 (intended changes): eye_parity 0 -> 9 because the gate uses the one eye check `compare` prints as 'eyes found N kept M' (it no longer skips small whites; a lone highlight beside an outline or a scattered sparkle is not an eye, a white with a coloured iris is). Judged at zoom: a few real lost eyes and a few false positives (highlights, glows, closed eyes) remain. flat 5 -> 72: a material the source draws with two or more tones (each at least 8%, 16+ cells in the art, art colour of the same hue) that the art draws with one tone over 93% of its cells, and only where a palette of the cell holds another tone of that hue or a slot is spare; palette-forced cases are a note, not a warning. identity_colour (26), consistency and readability are unchanged.
